key: I get that they want to improve the quality of living in Reborn,
en: I get that they want to improve the quality of living in Reborn,
ja: リボーンの生活の質を上げたいっていうのはわかるけど、

key: But how much longer do we have to wait for our home to be finished?
en: But how much longer do we have to wait for our home to be finished?
ja: 家が完成するまで、あとどれだけ待てばいいわけ?

key: We've been here twice as long as they promised already!
en: We've been here twice as long as they promised already!
ja: 約束されてた期間の倍、もうここにいるんだよ!

key: Well, this whole 'pay it forward' deal sure is nice!
en: Well, this whole 'pay it forward' deal sure is nice!
ja: この「恩送り」ってやつ、なかなかいいもんだね!

key: People get me a nicer room and then I don't have to do a thing!
en: People get me a nicer room and then I don't have to do a thing!
ja: 誰かがもっといい部屋をくれて、こっちは何もしなくていいなんて!

key: I ain't signed a contract, so I don't gotta lift a finger!
en: I ain't signed a contract, so I don't gotta lift a finger!
ja: 契約書にサインなんてしてねえから、指一本動かす必要もねえしな!

key: You know how long it's been since I had a roof over my head that don't leak?
en: You know how long it's been since I had a roof over my head that don't leak?
ja: 雨漏りしない屋根の下で暮らすの、どれくらいぶりだと思う?

key: Cuz me neither.
en: Cuz me neither.
ja: だってあたしもわかんないもん。

key: Do I gotta give this room up after so long?
en: Do I gotta give this room up after so long?
ja: こんなに長くいたのに、この部屋を明け渡さないといけないの?

key: I can't just stay here permanently?
en: I can't just stay here permanently?
ja: ずっとここに住み続けちゃダメなのかな?

key: But the CITY is the one who blew up my home, so why not?!
en: But the CITY is the one who blew up my home, so why not?!
ja: でも、あたしの家を吹き飛ばしたのは市のほうなんだから、いいじゃない?!

key: Can't say I ever expected to end up in a place like this.
en: Can't say I ever expected to end up in a place like this.
ja: こんな場所に行き着くとは思ってもみなかったよ。

key: But I guess it's not the absolute worst it could be.
en: But I guess it's not the absolute worst it could be.
ja: でも、最悪ってわけでもないか。

key: I should just hit the road.
en: I should just hit the road.
ja: そろそろ出発するべきかな。

key: If there's anything you need in your time here, please just ask one of the staff.
en: If there's anything you need in your time here, please just ask one of the staff.
ja: ここでの滞在中に何か必要なことがあれば、遠慮なくスタッフにお尋ねください。

key: Oh, I beg your pardon, you're not staying here? My apologies...
en: Oh, I beg your pardon, you're not staying here? My apologies...
ja: あら、失礼しました、ここに滞在しているわけではないんですね? すみません……

key: We do, of course, offer job finding services to all of our clients who may need it, however...
en: We do, of course, offer job finding services to all of our clients who may need it, however...
ja: もちろん、必要とされる利用者の方には求職支援サービスも提供していますが……

key: The longer I work here, the more I find the problem with some people is not that there are no good jobs available,
en: The longer I work here, the more I find the problem with some people is not that there are no good jobs available,
ja: ここで働く年月が長くなるほど気づくのですが、一部の人にとっての問題は、良い仕事がないことではなく、

key: But rather that they are so unused to working, or getting along with others, or solving problems, or settling for what they can get,
en: But rather that they are so unused to working, or getting along with others, or solving problems, or settling for what they can get,
ja: むしろ、働くことや、人と折り合いをつけること、問題を解決すること、手に入るもので満足することに、慣れていないという点なんです。

key: That it is not a challenge they are equal to.
en: That it is not a challenge they are equal to.
ja: 自分にはこなせない課題だと感じてしまうんです。

key: But even acknowledging that problem, I'm afraid I don't have a solution.
en: But even acknowledging that problem, I'm afraid I don't have a solution.
ja: その問題を理解してはいても、残念ながら解決策は持ち合わせていません。

key: Hey, you.
en: Hey, you.
ja: おい、お前。

key: Yeah, you.
en: Yeah, you.
ja: そうだよ、お前。

key: I see you.
en: I see you.
ja: 見えてるぞ。

key: Walkin' around with ya damn leaden pockets...
en: Walkin' around with ya damn leaden pockets...
ja: 重たいポケットぶら下げて歩きやがって……

key: What about us 99% huh?!
en: What about us 99% huh?!
ja: 残りの99パーセントの俺たちはどうなるんだよ、ああ?!

key: Do you even know what it means to be broke?!
en: Do you even know what it means to be broke?!
ja: 文無しって意味、お前にわかるのか?!

key: I bet some kinda middle-class brown noser like you wouldn't know poverty if it slapped you in the face!
en: I bet some kinda middle-class brown noser like you wouldn't know poverty if it slapped you in the face!
ja: お前みたいな中流のごますりには、貧乏なんてほおをひっぱたかれてもわからねえだろうよ!

key: You wanna prove me wrong?
en: You wanna prove me wrong?
ja: 違うって証明してみせるか?

key: Next time someone asks you for a password, try tellin' em "penniless"!
en: Next time someone asks you for a password, try tellin' em "penniless"!
ja: 今度誰かにパスワードを聞かれたら「文無し」って答えてみろ!

key: See how you like it then.
en: See how you like it then.
ja: それでどんな気分か味わってみろよ。

key: You got the same kinda vibe as I do, huh?
en: You got the same kinda vibe as I do, huh?
ja: お前、俺と同じ匂いがするな?

key: The same kinda gall.
en: The same kinda gall.
ja: 同じ図太さってやつだ。

key: Folks like us know how to drift and thrift.
en: Folks like us know how to drift and thrift.
ja: 俺たちみたいな連中は、流れながら、やりくりする術を知ってるもんだ。

key: Big respect, my buddy.
en: Big respect, my buddy.
ja: リスペクトするぜ、相棒。

key: Tell you what, I got ahold of this through some... uh... questionable means, but...
en: Tell you what, I got ahold of this through some... uh...  questionable means, but...
ja: 実はな、これ、その……ちょっとやばい方法で手に入れたんだけどよ……

key: I want you to have it.
en: I want you to have it.
ja: お前に持っててほしいんだ。

key: Know that I see your spirit.
en: Know that I see your spirit.
ja: お前の心意気、ちゃんと見てるからな。

key: Know that you are recognized.
en: Know that you are recognized.
ja: 認めてるってことを知っといてくれ。

key: If you can get through this?
en: If you can get through this?
ja: これを乗り越えられたら?

key: Heh, you can probably get through anything.
en: Heh, you can probably get through anything.
ja: へっ、お前ならどんなことでも乗り越えられるはずだ。
